statements.subject: task
statements.description: Agent requires additional input to complete a task; task status state is TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Follow-up message object includes taskId field to associate the message with an existing task: {"taskId": "task-uuid", "role": "ROLE_USER", "parts": [{"text": "From San Francisco to New York"}], "messageId": "msg-2"}

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Task response object includes id field and status object; status object includes state field set to TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED and a message field containing the agent's clarifying question

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Task status object includes a message field (role: ROLE_AGENT) containing the agent's request for additional information when state is TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Agent responds to initial message send with TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED when it requires additional input to complete the task; response includes agent message asking for clarification
actions: server creates task with id task-uuid
server includes agent clarification message in task.status.message
server returns HTTP 200 with task object

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Client sends follow-up message with taskId referencing the existing task to provide the additional input requested while task is in TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED
actions: client sends POST /message:send with message.taskId set to existing task id
client provides requested additional input in message.parts
client assigns new messageId msg-2 to follow-up message
